title: Owner approval for policy changes
summary: Treat agent-authored rules as proposals. Only the item owner may approve and publish a policy revision.
body: Submit a proposal with rationale and source. Do not publish until owner approval is recorded.

title: Myrmidon API reference
summary: Use company-scoped REST routes; validate actor permissions and read back mutations.
body: Examples must use company-scoped routes and avoid logging authorization headers.

title: Lesson: stale policy cache
summary: A stale cache must be visibly marked; do not treat unavailable policy data as current approval.
body: Observed: stale policy data can mislead automation. Record freshness and fail closed on critical actions.
